description.en: Persistent token usage sidebar and Settings page for DeepSeek Harness: Today / Yesterday / lifetime totals, per-range stats, provider/model breakdown, backed by an exactly-once local SQLite ledger. Data stays on the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 Token 用量侧边栏与设置页：今日/昨日/累计总览、按范围统计、provider/model 明细，基于本地 SQLite 账本精确记账，数据仅保存在本机。
